findings.summary: the plan's literal FENCE—EVIDENCE requires the four analytic rows' crossings/vertices/moments to be bit-identical or agree to 1e-14 relative with the previous evaluator; the node's own summary.json records previous_route_equivalence_1e14=false on all 8 analytic rows (64/64 measured quantities), relative_l2 up to 6.905e-12 (~690x the stated bound), and the measurement script hardcodes previous_route_equivalence_is_acceptance_gate=False, silently substituting an independent exact-reference no-worse comparison for the literally-specified acceptance gate without ever reporting this substitution as a blocker in the manifest, the plan's landing prose, or the coordinator's adjudication text

two separate allocations measuring essentially the same candidate program report meaningfully different serialized byte counts (164,997,235 bytes in job 1275837 vs 174,134,951 bytes in job 1275914, a ~5.5%/9.1MB spread) with no discussion anywhere of cross-allocation measurement stability, though both remain far above the 100MB ceiling so the headline conclusion is unaffected

the exact-reference no-worse comparison, which is the numerical fidelity property actually being relied on for acceptance now that previous-route equivalence has been dropped, exists only as a one-off measurement artifact (summary.json) rather than as a committed pytest assertion, so a future change could regress the four already-failing quantities further, or newly fail others, with no test catching it

justifications.durability: The new tests exercise the actual changed mechanism rather than a synthetic stand-in: test_binomial_lookup_lowers_without_special_functions (tests/test_interpolant.py:141) asserts the compiled lowering's text excludes 'lgamma' and 'gamma' while reproducing the correct binomial row [0,1,4,6,4,1,0] for order 4 — a real negative-space regression guard against the traced evaluator returning. test_static_bernstein_reproduces_constants_and_linear_fields and test_bicubic_derivatives_lower_to_static_polynomials add further coverage of the precomputed-basis path. I independently confirmed the candidate suite's 40-pass/0-fail result and the base revision's 6 pre-existing, unrelated failures from the fresh-process logs on disk. The gap: the no-worse property against the exact-arithmetic reference — now the operative numerical-fidelity gate given the previous-route-equivalence substitution — lives only in a one-off measurement artifact (summary.json) with no committed pytest assertion, so nothing in the test suite would catch further regression of the four already-failing quantities, or a new failure appearing elsewhere, on a subsequent change to this code.
justifications.evidence: Nearly every headline number I checked traces exactly to a artifact on disk: candidate/baseline serialized bytes and HLO op counts (bernstein-reference-audit/summary.json), the 12-of-16 no-worse split with the four 1e-16-absolute-scale exceptions (independent_reference.production/bicubic rows, recomputed independently and matched to the manifest's own numbers), the negative control's marker return and +80-byte delta (bernstein/negative-program.json and .log, first line 'restore the traced binomial evaluation'), and the 16+12+12=40 passing tests across three fresh-process logs with the pre-existing 6 base-revision failures unrelated to this change (bernstein-reference/suites.log). The one material evidence gap: the summary.json field previous_route_equivalence_1e14 is false on all 8 analytic rows and is never mentioned in any manifest field, commit message, or the plan's landing prose — a reader relying on those narrative surfaces alone would never learn that the literally-specified acceptance criterion failed on 100% of the rows it was measured against.
justifications.fit: Across all 26 of the node's own commits (237 total touched paths, verified via git show --name-only), every path falls inside the declared FENCE—SCOPE list; no concurrent §3 node's declared files are touched; no plan/sprint/ticket label or AI attribution string appears in any commit message, symbol, or comment; every commit carries a non-empty body. The node correctly defers the remaining instruction-owner reduction (separatrix_clip.py 86,407, clip_quadrature.py 77,276, forward_operator.py 71,548 instructions, the latter peer-owned) to follow_ons rather than touching those files. Set against that: the plan carries an open decision ('fallback-fence-norm': what fences the rows sitting at the fan's refinement floor) that is directly adjacent to the unresolved previous-route-equivalence gap, and the node neither engages with that open decision nor flags the connection when reporting its own numerical follow-on.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the core mechanism goal is achieved and independently verified: Bernstein.binom is absent from the candidate's optimized HLO (bernstein_binom_present=false, static_basis_present=true in bernstein-reference-audit/summary.json), and the negative control (restore the traced binomial evaluation) reproduces the marker and raises serialized bytes by +80 against its own same-allocation baseline (207,227,911 to 207,227,991 in bernstein/negative-program.json), exactly as the manifest claims. The byte-ceiling goal ('falls under the route-integrity ceiling') is explicitly NOT met — 174,134,951 bytes against a 100,000,000-byte target — but this is honestly and consistently reported at every level: the manifest, the plan's landed prose, and a dedicated promote(...):failed commit (abeccb9e4). Set against that: the plan's own FENCE—EVIDENCE also requires the four analytic rows' crossings, vertices and moments to be bit-identical or agree to 1e-14 relative with the previous evaluator, and the run's own summary.json shows this literal criterion fails on every one of 64 measured row/quantity pairs (relative_l2 from 9.0e-14 to 6.9e-12, up to ~690x over bound, array_equal=false throughout). The node's own script hardcodes this comparison as non-gating and substitutes an exact-arithmetic no-worse comparison instead, but that substitution is never surfaced as a deviation from the written measure — not in blockers, not in follow_ons, not in the plan comments, not in the coordinator's own adjudication, despite SPEC requiring deviations to be reported as blockers.
justifications.scope_discipline: The node's ephemeral measurement drivers (measure_bernstein.py, measure_reference.py, replay_reference.py, summarize_reference.py, probe_*.py) are committed under docs/figures/exact-clip-closed-form/, which is an explicitly declared write path, so this is legitimate rather than throwaway benchmark code leaking outside scope. All 26 commits stay within the five source/test files and the declared docs/figures and docs/plans/evidence paths; no peer node's files (e.g. nova/equilibrium/forward.py, forward_operator.py, the seven fsa-* figure trees, the pta-* topology files) are touched anywhere in the diff.

SCORE goal_fidelity: 12
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: Bernstein.binom removal from the traced HLO is achieved and verified by both the executable census and negative control. The byte-ceiling target is missed but honestly reported everywhere. However the plan's own FENCE—EVIDENCE requires the four analytic rows to be bit-identical or 1e-14 relative to the previous evaluator, and the node's own summary.json shows this fails on all 64 measured row/quantity pairs (up to 690x over bound); the node's script hardcodes this as non-gating and substitutes an exact-reference no-worse comparison, but never reports that substitution as a deviation despite SPEC requiring it be flagged as a blocker.
SCORE evidence: 13
JUSTIFICATION evidence: every headline number (byte counts, HLO markers, negative control delta, 12-of-16 no-worse split, 40-pass test count) traces exactly to artifacts on disk and I independently recomputed the key ones. The material gap is transparency: the previous_route_equivalence_1e14=false result sitting in the same summary.json used for everything else is never surfaced in any manifest field, commit message, or plan prose.
SCORE fit: 16
JUSTIFICATION fit: all 237 touched paths across 26 commits verified inside the declared fence; no concurrent-node files touched; no plan/ticket labels or AI attribution; every commit has a body. Deducted for not engaging with the plan's directly adjacent open decision (fallback-fence-norm) when reporting the unresolved numerical follow-on.
SCORE scope_discipline: 18
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: ephemeral drivers are committed under the declared docs/figures/exact-clip-closed-form path, not leaked outside scope; no peer §3 node's files are touched anywhere in the diff; remaining instruction-owner work correctly deferred to follow_ons rather than touched directly.
SCORE durability: 16
JUSTIFICATION durability: new tests exercise the real mechanism, including a negative-space HLO-text assertion against 'gamma'/'lgamma' reappearing; I independently confirmed the 40-pass/0-added-failure result. Deducted because the no-worse numerical-fidelity property, now the operative acceptance gate, exists only as a measurement artifact with no committed pytest assertion guarding it.
